comment: C ref: makemon.c makemon() tail (1502-1504) under an occupation. A debug-mode terrain wish places an unseen statue trap; after stepping off it, a counted search runs as the 'searching' occupation, detect.c dosearch0() finds the trap and trap.c activate_statue_trap() animates the statue through makemon(), whose dochugw() check reaches allmain.c stop_occupation(). Seed, clock and character chosen independently.
